{{Quote|The Keeper can send probes like ''these'' anywhere on the planet as part of our ''rebuilding'' process--|Fire|<ref name="TFF" />}}
The '''Keeper's probes''' were robotic arms that could travel anywhere on the [[Keeper's World]]. While [[The Keeper]] was tasked by her [[Keeper's makers|makers]] with restoring their war-ravaged planet, the Keeper herself was confined to the caverns beneath her [[Keeper's Temple|temple]]. She sent out her probes to do much of the actual work. After the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]] she used her probes to repair a [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|scout craft]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] so that [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] could continue their [[Mission to Akuria II]].
